summary: Meshflow Acquisition Corp, a Cayman SPAC, filed an 8-K on September 5, 2026 disclosing a Business Combination Agreement with HGP Intelligent Energy, a Wyoming nuclear-tech developer. The deal involves a Domestication to Delaware, a Meshflow merger into a Pubco subsidiary, and HGP merging into a second Pubco subsidiary, with Pubco becoming publicly traded. No price per share, premium, or break fee was disclosed in the excerpt; no advisor or board recommendation named. The structural sequence mirrors a de-SPAC merger. Watch for redemption levels, PIPE financing, and Nasdaq listing approval as the closing risk-arb pivot.
